verdict.rationale: LibreChat supports creating multiple distinct Agents with their own prompts, models, tools, and avatars, invokable via @mention or endpoint selection, and even Subagents/Agent Management API for orchestration. However, evidence does not show 'workspaces' per agent or explicit routing of conversations/channels to specific agents beyond manual selection/mention. missing for 10: dedicated per-agent workspace isolation, automatic channel/conversation routing rules to specific agents, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent orchestration at scale.
